create_new_project: create a new crowdsourcing project with a given name using Project.new
get_project_by_id: get an existing project from the database using Project.get with a db_id
get_project_tasks: get the list of tasks associated with a project using get_tasks
get_project_total_spend: get the total funding spent across all tasks in a project using get_total_spend
review_project_class: review the Project class for budgeting and grouping crowdsourcing tasks
